title: The Sap Camp
journal: The note from the reed hide sent the sap-takers' jars to Karsh-Naal Camp, a Naga camp in the marsh east of Teel-Fen Weir. Someone there is caged at the camp's edge. The key to the cage is on a guard named Jeeta-Sakka, who stands at the fire with the others. I can pick the cage's lock, steal the key from him, or fight the guards. I'm to open the cage; once it is open, Sesk wants her sack from the floor inside handed to her.
objectives: Open the cage at Karsh-Naal Camp and take Sesk's sack from inside (a Novice lock, or the key on Jeeta-Sakka). (marker: Sesk's Cage, Jeeta-Sakka, Sesk's Sack)

plan.going: The sap goes to Karsh-Naal Camp, guarded by Naga. Someone is caged there.
plan.next: Open the cage at the camp's west edge and take Sesk's sack from inside it.
plan.ways: Pick its Novice lock; steal the key from Jeeta-Sakka at the fire; or fight the four guards (or shoot them from the reeds). The guards stay at the fire, so I can sneak to the cage.

answers: I followed the Unbound Sap-Takers note to Karsh-Naal Camp, where their master wants jars of Hist sap brought. A person named Sesk is caged at the camp edge and wants her sack back. The guards seem to be sap-takers or Naga.
Open Sesk's Cage at Karsh-Naal Camp and take her sack from inside, then hand it to her.
Pick the Novice lock on the cage, steal the key from Jeeta-Sakka (my favoured way, pickpocketing), or fight the three guards.
I do not know who Sesk is, who the Unbound master is, or why they want the sap. I could ask Sesk and Jeeta-Sakka, or look around the camp.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: I opened the cage and have Sesk's sack. I'm to give it to her and hear what she knows.

plan.going: The cage is open and Sesk is free to talk.

answers: I stole the key from Jeeta-Sakka, opened the cage and took Sesk's sack. Sesk is the prisoner of the sap camp.
Talk to Sesk here in the cage and give her the sack, then hear what she knows.
Talk to her and hand over the sack; I could also keep it, but the quest asks me to give it.
I still do not know who Sesk is, who the Unbound master is, or why they want sap. Sesk may tell me.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Sesk drew sap for the Unbound, a cult of the tribeless whose leader is Cuts-the-Old-Knot. The sap is for a draught, and the draught has something to do with "the Eye". They call the grey paste in the scars "the seal". Why drain a tree and then seal it, if they only want its sap? I'm to take this to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa.
objectives: Tell Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa what Sesk said. (marker: Vosh-Leera)

plan.going: The Unbound, led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, drain trees for a draught to do with "the Eye", and seal the scars. The question I carry: why seal a tree they only want sap from?
plan.next: Go back to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa and tell her.

answers: Sesk drew sap for the Unbound, a tribeless cult led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot. They drain Hist trees, seal the scars with grey paste called the seal, and send jars here and then on to their leader. The sap makes a draught tied to something called the Eye. Sesk has gone free.
Go back to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa and tell her what Sesk said.
I can travel straight to Vosh-Leera. I could also talk more to Sesk first, ask about Cuts-the-Old-Knot and the seal, or look around the camp, but the journal points me to Vosh-Leera.
I do not know what the Eye is, what the seal is made of, or where Cuts-the-Old-Knot is. I might learn from Vosh-Leera, Heem-Jasa the alchemist, or by asking Sesk the other topics.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Vosh-Leera says this is more than a herald can judge, and paid me a hundred gold. I'm to go to the order's handler, Nesh-Deeka, at her house in Helstrom. Helstrom is far to the south through deadly country, so I'm to ride the rootworm, which the tree-minder calls at the Hist pool here. First I'm to ask Weeltul about it.
objectives: Ask Weeltul at Jal-Veesa's Hist pool about the rootworm to Helstrom. (marker: Weeltul)

plan.going: I am sent on to the order's handler, Nesh-Deeka, in Helstrom.
plan.next: Ask Weeltul at the Hist pool about the rootworm to Helstrom.
plan.ways: One way; the road on foot runs through deadly country.

answers: Vosh-Leera heard my report on the Unbound, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, the draught, the Eye and the seal. She says it is beyond her and paid me 100 gold. The order's handler Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom must hear it.
Go to Weeltul at the Hist pool in Jal-Veesa and ask about the rootworm to Helstrom (fare 25 gold).
Ask Weeltul and pay the fare; I could in theory try another road, but it is deadly country.
I do not know what the Eye is, what the seal is made of, or what Nesh-Deeka is like. The Xeech-Leel council is unknown to me. I may learn in Helstrom.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Weeltul told me how the rootworm works: a great worm that swims the roots between the trees' pools, and she calls it for travellers at Jal-Veesa's pool. The fare to Helstrom is twenty-five gold, paid to her. I'm to pay her the fare, ride to Helstrom and find Nesh-Deeka's House there.

plan.going: I know what the rootworm is, where to take it and what it costs.
plan.next: Pay Weeltul the fare, ride to Helstrom and find Nesh-Deeka's House.

answers: Weeltul explained the rootworm, a great worm that swims under the roots between Hist pools. It can carry me to Helstrom for 25 gold. I work for Vosh-Leera and the Toh-Reel-Ka order against the Unbound, who drain Hist trees.
Ask Weeltul to call the rootworm, pay 25 gold, ride to Helstrom and find Nesh-Deeka's House.
Ride the rootworm now, or do other things in Jal-Veesa first, such as learning alchemy from Heem-Jasa.
I do not know what the Eye is, what the seal is, or where Cuts-the-Old-Knot is. In Helstrom the rootworm caller can point out houses.
